research_question: Is the larger Q.ANT prediction disagreement of g8 explained by larger accumulated logit error interacting with small reference decision margins?
observations: Exp016 found nearly identical high-residual phase-bin occupancy for g4 and g8 despite much higher disagreement for g8.
A classification can flip when accumulated deployment error exceeds the reference top-1/top-2 margin even if individual activation errors are small.
hypothesis: Compared with g4, g8 will show larger reference-to-Q.ANT logit error, and disagreement cases will be concentrated among samples whose reference top-1/top-2 margin is small relative to the induced logit perturbation.
falsification_criterion: The hypothesis is weakened if g8 does not show larger logit error than g4, or if disagreement is not strongly enriched among low-margin samples.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
Three seeds and three epochs limit precision.
Margin association can explain sensitivity but does not by itself identify the upstream numerical source of every logit error.
